# open_sol API reference

Regenerate with: python -m open_sol describe --update-reference (also writes api_templates.md)

Generated by describe() from the registry (physics, feature, coupling and study types), the model spec, the expression vocabulary, the material library and the templates; selftest fails while this file differs from it. The template model JSON is in api_templates.md beside this file.

Workflow: write the closest template (Templates) to a model JSON file with python -m open_sol template KEY model.json, edit it, run python -m open_sol check model.json (check.json), then python -m open_sol run model.json --figures (summary.json, log.txt, figures/); --set NAME=EXPR changes a parameter for one check / run. Units are SI unless a unit says otherwise; every wavelength is a vacuum wavelength.

More worked model files (examples/<physics area>/*.json, one folder per physics area plus multiphysics, many with an analytic reference; scripts in examples/em, examples/multiphysics and examples/headless_run.py) live in the examples folder beside the package (examples/README.md); they are not part of this reference.

Topics (describe(topic) or python -m open_sol describe <topic>): spec, expressions, geometry, materials, mesh, solvers, each physics type name, `<physics>.<feature>`, each coupling type name, each study type name, templates, results, selftests.

Line ranges in api_reference.md (Read with offset / limit; Grep '^## ' lists the same headings). Sections over 400 lines also list their subsections. A line "Help: shared `<key>`" stands for the text under "#### `<key>`" in Shared help texts (Grep it); every occurrence of a repeated long text, the first included, points there.
