- `pml_cells` (int; default 8; range [1, 100]) - PML element layers
  Thickness of the elastic PML shell in element layers of the mesh dx (h_max) on every pml_<face> face; the profile needs about 6-10 layers, and the shell should span a fair part of the longest wavelength (c / f at the target) for a low reflection.
- `pml_reflection` (float; unit 1; default 1e-06; range (0, 1]) - PML reflection
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.pml_reflection`

### Material properties (MaterialSpec.properties)

- `youngs_modulus` (float; unit Pa; range [0, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays youngs_modulus) - Young's modulus
  Help: shared `elastic_waves.youngs_modulus`
- `poisson_ratio` (float; unit 1; range (-1, 0.499]; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays poisson_ratio) - Poisson ratio
  Help: shared `elastic_waves.poisson_ratio`
- `alpha` (float; unit 1/K; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays alpha_xx, alpha_yy, alpha_zz) - Thermal expansion coefficient
  Linear thermal expansion coefficient; also read by heat_em_thermo_optic (see the heat type).
- `alpha_xx` (float; unit 1/K; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays alpha_xx) - Thermal expansion along x
  Expansion coefficient along x (see alpha).
- `alpha_yy` (float; unit 1/K; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays alpha_yy) - Thermal expansion along y
  Expansion coefficient along y (see alpha).
- `alpha_zz` (float; unit 1/K; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays alpha_zz) - Thermal expansion along z
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.alpha_zz`
- `photoelastic_p11` (float; unit 1; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays photoelastic_p11) - Photoelastic coefficient p11
  Help: shared `elastic_waves.photoelastic_p11`
- `photoelastic_p12` (float; unit 1; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays photoelastic_p12) - Photoelastic coefficient p12
  Help: shared `elastic_waves.photoelastic_p12`
- `rho` (float; unit kg/m^3; range [0, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays rho) - Density
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.rho`
- `c11` (float; unit Pa; range [0, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c11) - Stiffness c11
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.c11`
- `c12` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c12) - Stiffness c12
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.c12`
- `c13` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c13) - Stiffness c13
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.c13`
- `c14` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c14) - Stiffness c14
  Anisotropic stiffness entry c14 [Pa] (xx-yz) of the Voigt matrix in model axes (1 xx, 2 yy, 3 zz, 4 yz, 5 xz, 6 xy; engineering shear, S_4 = 2 strain_yz): T_I = c_IJ S_J - beta_I dT with beta_I = c_IJ alpha_J. Read only by solid_mechanics_3d on a tetrahedron mesh (a rectangular-cell mesh refuses c_ij entries), which takes all 21 entries c11 .. c66 (the 2D names keep their meaning); any entry set allocates all 21. Unset = 0 (c11, c22, c33: lambda + 2 mu, c12, c13, c23: lambda, c44, c55, c66: mu of youngs_modulus / poisson_ratio; every other entry 0), so a cell with only c_ij entries needs the nine of the orthotropic pattern. The 6 x 6 matrix must be positive definite (build error); a cell is solid when its c11 > 0. Usually set by a {'model': 'crystal'} entry with 'plane': 'full'.
- `c15` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c15) - Stiffness c15
  Anisotropic stiffness entry c15 [Pa] (xx-xz) of the Voigt matrix in model axes (1 xx, 2 yy, 3 zz, 4 yz, 5 xz, 6 xy; engineering shear, S_4 = 2 strain_yz): T_I = c_IJ S_J - beta_I dT with beta_I = c_IJ alpha_J. Read only by solid_mechanics_3d on a tetrahedron mesh (a rectangular-cell mesh refuses c_ij entries), which takes all 21 entries c11 .. c66 (the 2D names keep their meaning); any entry set allocates all 21. Unset = 0 (c11, c22, c33: lambda + 2 mu, c12, c13, c23: lambda, c44, c55, c66: mu of youngs_modulus / poisson_ratio; every other entry 0), so a cell with only c_ij entries needs the nine of the orthotropic pattern. The 6 x 6 matrix must be positive definite (build error); a cell is solid when its c11 > 0. Usually set by a {'model': 'crystal'} entry with 'plane': 'full'.
- `c16` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c16) - Stiffness c16
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.c16`
- `c22` (float; unit Pa; range [0, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c22) - Stiffness c22
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.c22`
- `c23` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c23) - Stiffness c23
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.c23`
- `c24` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays c24) - Stiffness c24
  Anisotropic stiffness entry c24 [Pa] (yy-yz) of the Voigt matrix in model axes (1 xx, 2 yy, 3 zz, 4 yz, 5 xz, 6 xy; engineering shear, S_4 = 2 strain_yz): T_I = c_IJ S_J - beta_I dT with beta_I = c_IJ alpha_J. Read only by solid_mechanics_3d on a tetrahedron mesh (a rectangular-cell mesh refuses c_ij entries), which takes all 21 entries c11 .. c66 (the 2D names keep their meaning); any entry set allocates all 21. Unset = 0 (c11, c22, c33: lambda + 2 mu, c12, c13, c23: lambda, c44, c55, c66: mu of youngs_modulus / poisson_ratio; every other entry 0), so a cell with only c_ij entries needs the nine of the orthotropic pattern. The 6 x 6 matrix must be positive definite (build error); a cell is solid when its c11 > 0. Usually set by a {'model': 'crystal'} entry with 'plane': 'full'.

- `eps_dc` (float; unit 1; range [1, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays eps_dc_xx, eps_dc_yy, eps_dc_zz) - Static relative permittivity
  Isotropic static relative permittivity (>= 1): in solid_mechanics_3d it sets eps_dc_xx, eps_dc_yy and eps_dc_zz (component entries override it); unset = 1 (vacuum). Read only with piezoelectric on (tetrahedra), as the clamped permittivity eps^S of every window element, void ones included.
- `eps_dc_xx` (float; unit 1; range [1, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays eps_dc_xx) - Static relative permittivity along x
  Static relative permittivity along x (>= 1); overrides eps_dc for this axis.
- `eps_dc_yy` (float; unit 1; range [1, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays eps_dc_yy) - Static relative permittivity along y
  Static relative permittivity along y (>= 1); overrides eps_dc for this axis.
- `eps_dc_zz` (float; unit 1; range [1, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays eps_dc_zz) - Static relative permittivity along z
  Static relative permittivity along z (>= 1; solid_mechanics_3d with piezoelectric on); overrides eps_dc for this axis.
- `eps_dc_yz` (float; unit 1; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays eps_dc_yz) - Static relative permittivity, cross term yz
  Off-diagonal static permittivity yz of a rotated anisotropic material (solid_mechanics_3d with piezoelectric on); the 3 x 3 eps_dc must be positive definite (else the build fails). Default 0.
- `eps_dc_xz` (float; unit 1; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays eps_dc_xz) - Static relative permittivity, cross term xz
  Off-diagonal static permittivity xz of a rotated anisotropic material (solid_mechanics_3d with piezoelectric on); the 3 x 3 eps_dc must be positive definite (else the build fails). Default 0.
- `eps_dc_xy` (float; unit 1; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays eps_dc_xy) - Static relative permittivity, cross term
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.eps_dc_xy`
- `mechanical_loss_factor` (float; unit 1; range [0, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays mechanical_loss_factor) - Mechanical loss factor
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.mechanical_loss_factor`
- `dielectric_loss_tangent` (float; unit 1; range [0, inf); optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays dielectric_loss_tangent) - Dielectric loss tangent

  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.initial_stress_xx`
- `initial_stress_yy` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays initial_stress_yy) - Initial stress yy
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.initial_stress_yy`

  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.initial_stress_zz`
- `initial_stress_yz` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays initial_stress_yz) - Initial stress yz
  Initial (residual) stress sigma0_yz [Pa] of the cell, e.g. the deposition stress of a film (tension > 0): the total stress is sigma0 + C eps - beta dT, so a stationary solve relaxes it (a released structure contracts until the total stress balances the supports); default 0. Triangle and tetrahedron meshes only (a rectangular-cell mesh refuses it). solid_mechanics_3d only (a Voigt row). With the stress_stiffening setting the eigenfrequency / frequency_response / optomechanics studies add the geometric stiffness K_sigma of the static state (a tensioned string or membrane rises in frequency). Constant per element (an x / y / z expression is evaluated at the centroids).
- `initial_stress_xz` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays initial_stress_xz) - Initial stress xz
  Initial (residual) stress sigma0_xz [Pa] of the cell, e.g. the deposition stress of a film (tension > 0): the total stress is sigma0 + C eps - beta dT, so a stationary solve relaxes it (a released structure contracts until the total stress balances the supports); default 0. Triangle and tetrahedron meshes only (a rectangular-cell mesh refuses it). solid_mechanics_3d only (a Voigt row). With the stress_stiffening setting the eigenfrequency / frequency_response / optomechanics studies add the geometric stiffness K_sigma of the static state (a tensioned string or membrane rises in frequency). Constant per element (an x / y / z expression is evaluated at the centroids).
- `initial_stress_xy` (float; unit Pa; optional (null allowed); may use x, y; may use physics fields; writes arrays initial_stress_xy) - Initial stress xy
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics.initial_stress_xy`

### Fields

State fields:
- `u_abs` - Displacement magnitude (m)
- `u_x` - Displacement x (m)
- `u_y` - Displacement y (m)
- `u_z` - Displacement z (m)
- `von_mises` - von Mises stress (Pa)
- `stress_xx` - Stress xx (Pa)
- `stress_yy` - Stress yy (Pa)
- `stress_zz` - Stress zz (Pa)
- `stress_xy` - Shear stress xy (Pa)
- `stress_xz` - Shear stress xz (Pa)
- `stress_yz` - Shear stress yz (Pa)
- `strain_xx` - Strain xx (1)
- `strain_yy` - Strain yy (1)
- `strain_zz` - Strain zz (1)
- `strain_xy` - Shear strain xy (1)
- `strain_xz` - Shear strain xz (1)
- `strain_yz` - Shear strain yz (1)
- `elastic_strain_xx` - Elastic strain xx (1)
- `elastic_strain_yy` - Elastic strain yy (1)
- `elastic_strain_zz` - Elastic strain zz (1)
- `temperature_rise` - Coupled temperature rise (K)
- `temperature_rise_ext` - Applied temperature change (K)
- `body_force_x` - Coupled body force x (N/m^3)
- `body_force_y` - Coupled body force y (N/m^3)
- `body_force_z` - Coupled body force z (N/m^3)
- `youngs_modulus` - Young's modulus (Pa)
- `poisson_ratio` - Poisson ratio (1)

Output fields (primary u_abs):
- `u_abs` - Displacement magnitude (m)
- `u_x` - Displacement x (m)
- `u_y` - Displacement y (m)
- `u_z` - Displacement z (m)
- `u_x_im` - Displacement x, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `u_y_im` - Displacement y, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `u_z_im` - Displacement z, imaginary part (m) [frequency_response study only]
- `von_mises` - von Mises stress (Pa)
- `stress_xx` - Stress xx (Pa)
- `stress_yy` - Stress yy (Pa)
- `stress_zz` - Stress zz (Pa)
- `stress_xy` - Shear stress xy (Pa)
- `stress_xz` - Shear stress xz (Pa)
- `stress_yz` - Shear stress yz (Pa)
- `strain_xx` - Strain xx (1)
- `strain_yy` - Strain yy (1)
- `strain_zz` - Strain zz (1)
- `strain_xy` - Shear strain xy (1)
- `strain_xz` - Shear strain xz (1)
- `strain_yz` - Shear strain yz (1)
- `elastic_strain_xx` - Elastic strain xx (1)
- `elastic_strain_yy` - Elastic strain yy (1)
- `elastic_strain_zz` - Elastic strain zz (1)
- `temperature_rise` - Coupled temperature rise (K)
- `temperature_rise_ext` - Applied temperature change (K)
- `body_force_x` - Coupled body force x (N/m^3)
- `body_force_y` - Coupled body force y (N/m^3)
- `body_force_z` - Coupled body force z (N/m^3)
- `electric_potential` - Electric potential (piezoelectric) (V)
- `electric_field_x` - Electric field x (piezoelectric) (V/m)
- `electric_field_y` - Electric field y (piezoelectric) (V/m)
- `electric_field_z` - Electric field z (piezoelectric) (V/m)
- `electric_displacement_x` - Electric displacement x (piezoelectric) (C/m^2)
- `electric_displacement_y` - Electric displacement y (piezoelectric) (C/m^2)
- `electric_displacement_z` - Electric displacement z (piezoelectric) (C/m^2)
- `strain_energy_density` - Strain energy density (J/m^3)
- `kinetic_energy_density` - Kinetic energy density (time average) (J/m^3)
- `youngs_modulus` - Young's modulus (Pa)
- `poisson_ratio` - Poisson ratio (1)

### Source slots

- `temperature_rise` (K): Coupled temperature above the stress-free state (heat_solid_thermal_strain: heat T - T0), added to the temperature_change features (field temperature_rise_ext); each transfer replaces it.
- `body_force_x` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along x, added to the body_force features; each transfer replaces it; void cells drop it.
- `body_force_y` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along y, as body_force_x.
- `body_force_z` (N/m^3): Coupled body force density along z, as body_force_x.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.fixed` - Fixed

Clamped support: u_x = u_y = u_z = 0. Outer faces, z_lo / z_hi included; on a tetrahedron mesh also domain objects (their interface faces, outer boundary faces of the object included; a tensor mesh refuses objects: use Fixed (domain) there). Holds every node of the faces, edges and corners included. Result 'table' of the latest solve with one row [feature, F_x, F_y, F_z] (units '', N, N, N) and the extras F_x, F_y and F_z: the force the support exerts on the solid (sum of K u - f over its held dofs, so components it does not hold read 0); a dof held by two supports counts in both (the later value holds it). After a frequency_response study on a tetrahedron mesh: a table of the complex reaction per solved frequency instead, columns frequency, F_x_re, F_x_im, F_y_re, F_y_im, F_z_re, F_z_im (Hz, N; the sum of the complex A x - f).

- FeatureSpec.type `fixed`; category boundary_condition
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): boundary entities; count at least 1; outer faces allowed; object perimeters allowed
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tensor, tetrahedra
- Result kind `table`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.roller` - Roller

Roller (symmetry) support: the normal displacement is 0 (u_x on x_lo / x_hi, u_y on y_lo / y_hi, u_z on z_lo / z_hi), the tangential ones free (zero shear traction). Rollers on one x, one y and one z face hold a solid completely. Outer faces only, z_lo / z_hi included (a support on an object boundary: Fixed (domain) on the object). Holds every node of the face, edges and corners included. Result 'table' of the latest solve with one row [feature, F_x, F_y, F_z] (units '', N, N, N) and the extras F_x, F_y and F_z: the force the support exerts on the solid (sum of K u - f over its held dofs, so components it does not hold read 0); a dof held by two supports counts in both (the later value holds it). After a frequency_response study on a tetrahedron mesh: a table of the complex reaction per solved frequency instead, columns frequency, F_x_re, F_x_im, F_y_re, F_y_im, F_z_re, F_z_im (Hz, N; the sum of the complex A x - f).

- FeatureSpec.type `roller`; category boundary_condition
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): boundary entities; count at least 1; outer faces allowed; object perimeters not allowed
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tensor, tetrahedra
- Result kind `table`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.prescribed_displacement_domain` - Prescribed displacement (domain)

Prescribed displacement per component on every corner node of the selected cells (a tetrahedron mesh: every node of the selected elements): u_x, u_y and / or u_z [m], an empty component stays free (validation error when all are empty), e.g. u_x = u_y = 0 with u_z free for a no-slip film. A 3D solid held so through its whole thickness cannot rotate its cross-sections: its bending turns into transverse shear and, with geometric nonlinearity, the membrane stretching is partly relieved by thickness change; a no-slip mid-surface (a shell model) is not the same constraint. A later support on the same node component sets its value. Result 'table' of the latest solve with one row [feature, F_x, F_y, F_z] (units '', N, N, N) and the extras F_x, F_y and F_z: the force the support exerts on the solid (sum of K u - f over its held dofs, so components it does not hold read 0); a dof held by two supports counts in both (the later value holds it). After a frequency_response study on a tetrahedron mesh: a table of the complex reaction per solved frequency instead, columns frequency, F_x_re, F_x_im, F_y_re, F_y_im, F_z_re, F_z_im (Hz, N; the sum of the complex A x - f).

- FeatureSpec.type `prescribed_displacement_domain`; category domain_condition
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): domain entities; count at least 1
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tensor, tetrahedra
- Result kind `table`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
- `u_x` (float; unit m; optional (null allowed)) - Displacement x
  Prescribed u_x [m] on every node of the selected domains; empty (null) leaves u_x free.
- `u_y` (float; unit m; optional (null allowed)) - Displacement y
  Prescribed u_y [m] on every node of the selected domains; empty (null) leaves u_y free.
- `u_z` (float; unit m; optional (null allowed)) - Displacement z

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.boundary_load` - Boundary load

Surface traction (t_x, t_y, t_z) [Pa] on outer faces, in the model axes (not the face normal): consistent nodal forces t times the tributary area of each face node (a quarter of each adjacent face cell) [N]. Several loads add; on a held component it only enters the reaction. On a tetrahedron mesh the consistent face loads int t N dA of the element faces beside a solid element, also on domain objects (their interface faces: between two solid elements a sheet force on both; a tensor mesh refuses objects).

- FeatureSpec.type `boundary_load`; category boundary_condition
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): boundary entities; count at least 1; outer faces allowed; object perimeters allowed
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tensor, tetrahedra
- Result: none

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
- `t_x` (float; unit Pa; default 0) - Traction x
  Force per area along +x on the selected outer faces (a pressure p pushing into the x_hi face is t_x = -p).
- `t_y` (float; unit Pa; default 0) - Traction y
  Force per area along +y on the selected outer faces (a pressure p on y_hi is t_y = -p).
- `t_z` (float; unit Pa; default -1e+06) - Traction z
  Force per area along +z on the selected outer faces (a pressure p on z_hi is t_z = -p). Typical 1e5-1e8.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.body_force` - Body force

Applied body force density [N/m^3], consistent nodal forces f times cell volume / 8 to the eight corners of each selected cell (a tetrahedron mesh: int f N dV with f per element at its centroid); void cells (youngs_modulus 0) drop it. Several body forces add; the coupled slots body_force_x / _y / _z are separate.

- FeatureSpec.type `body_force`; category domain_condition
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): domain entities; count at least 1
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tensor, tetrahedra
- Result: none

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
- `f_x` (float; unit N/m^3; default 0; may use x, y) - Body force x
  Force per volume along +x; may depend on x, y and z.
- `f_y` (float; unit N/m^3; default 0; may use x, y) - Body force y
  Force per volume along +y; may depend on x, y and z.
- `f_z` (float; unit N/m^3; default -21600; may use x, y) - Body force z
  Force per volume along +z; gravity along -z is -rho g (silica -2.16e4). May depend on x, y and z.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.solid_probe` - Solid probe

Samples one output field in the cell containing the point (its z param, mid-height when unset; one sample per re-solve and one per stationary iteration or end-of-run flush, all at t = 0 in a stationary study); on a tetrahedron mesh the nodal display field evaluated at the point (strain and stress: the node-averaged values).

- FeatureSpec.type `solid_probe`; category probe
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): point entities; object kinds point; count exactly 1
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tensor, tetrahedra
- Result kind `timeseries`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
- `component` (choice; default "u_abs"; choices u_x | u_y | u_z | u_abs | strain_xx | strain_yy | strain_zz | strain_xy | strain_xz | strain_yz | elastic_strain_xx | elastic_strain_yy | elastic_strain_zz | stress_xx | stress_yy | stress_zz | stress_xy | stress_xz | stress_yz | von_mises | electric_potential | electric_field_x | electric_field_y | electric_field_z | electric_displacement_x | electric_displacement_y | electric_displacement_z | strain_energy_density | kinetic_energy_density) - Quantity
  Output field sampled at the point (unit of that field); the electric_* ones (0 without piezoelectric) and the *_energy_density ones only on a tetrahedron mesh.

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.frequency_probe` - Frequency probe

frequency_response study only (triangle and tetrahedron meshes): the complex displacement (exp(+j omega t), phase 0 = the drive) at the point per solved frequency, the nodal field evaluated there (triangles: the mesher puts a node on the point; 0 off the solid). Result 'xy' versus frequency [Hz] (core.harmonic_probe series): u_x_re / _im / _abs / _phase, u_y_re / _im / _abs / _phase, u_z_re / _im / _abs / _phase (m; phase in rad, in (-pi, pi]); a derived value two_wave_fit pairs a _re series with its _im sibling. The record restarts with each frequency_response run.

- FeatureSpec.type `frequency_probe`; category probe
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): point entities; object kinds point; count exactly 1
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tetrahedra
- Result kind `xy`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.resonance_table` - Resonance table

Vibration modes of the last eigenfrequency study solve, the lowest first on a tensor mesh (target_frequency reads 0); on a tetrahedron mesh nearest the target (the target_frequency setting) first. Result 'table', one row per mode: resonance_number, frequency, angular_frequency (1-based rank, Hz, rad/s); extras target_frequency (Hz) and selected_resonance. Undamped: every frequency is real (Q infinite), except with a resistive_load electrode (solid_mechanics_3d), which appends frequency_imag (Hz, > 0 decays), q_factor and energy_decay_rate (1/s, = 2 Im omega, the external coupling rate kappa_e). For a frequency versus a parameter add a derived value with source '<physics>.<this feature>', expression frequency, operation at and at = 0 (the first mode). With squeeze_film_damping features (tetrahedron mesh) the table appends gas_damping, gas_stiffness, gamma_gas, q_gas: the totals of every enabled film (per mode for the mode shape of the eigenfrequency study (peak |u| = 1 m): gas_damping c = -Re F [kg/s] and gas_stiffness k = omega Im F [N/m] of the modal gas force F = int p conj(w) dA per unit modal velocity (both scale with the square of the shape normalisation), gamma_gas = c / m_eff [1/s] (the energy decay rate, the linewidth in rad/s) and q_gas = omega m_eff / c, with m_eff = int rho |u|^2 dV of the same shape (independent of it); c, k and gamma add over the films).

- FeatureSpec.type `resonance_table`; category monitor
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): none (a selection is ignored with a warning)
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tensor, tetrahedra
- Result kind `table`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
none

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.squeeze_film_damping` - Squeeze-film damping

Gas damping of a thin film (gap H) between one flat face of the solid and a fixed parallel wall, evaluated per resonance after the eigenfrequency solve (tetrahedron mesh; it does not change the modes). Selection: one outer face, or domain objects with gap_side (their interface faces flat on that side form the footprint; a curved or stepped selection is a build error). On the footprint (a P2 triangle mesh of the tetrahedron faces) the linearised compressible Reynolds equation div(H^3 / (12 mu_eff) grad p) - j omega (H / p_a) p = j omega w is solved per mode, w = -u . n_out the gap-opening normal displacement of the mode, p = 0 on the vented rim edges (vents), no flux on sealed ones. Result 'table', one row per mode: resonance_number, frequency [Hz], effective_mass [kg], per mode for the mode shape of the eigenfrequency study (peak |u| = 1 m): gas_damping c = -Re F [kg/s] and gas_stiffness k = omega Im F [N/m] of the modal gas force F = int p conj(w) dA per unit modal velocity (both scale with the square of the shape normalisation), gamma_gas = c / m_eff [1/s] (the energy decay rate, the linewidth in rad/s) and q_gas = omega m_eff / c, with m_eff = int rho |u|^2 dV of the same shape (independent of it); extras area [m^2], gap [m], surface_elements, vent_edges. The Resonance table appends gas_damping, gas_stiffness, gamma_gas and q_gas summed over every enabled film (select each face once). Complex modes (PML, loss, resistive loads) use Re omega and m_eff = Re(u^H M u); Bloch cells refuse it. Only the eigenfrequency study evaluates it.

- FeatureSpec.type `squeeze_film_damping`; category monitor
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): boundary entities; count at least 1; outer faces allowed; object perimeters allowed
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tetrahedra
- Result kind `table`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
- `gap` (float; unit m; default 2e-06; range (0, inf)) - Gap height
  Help: shared `membrane.squeeze_film_damping.gap`
- `viscosity` (float; unit Pa s; default 1.81e-05; range (0, inf)) - Gas viscosity
  Dynamic viscosity mu of the gas [Pa s] (air at 20 C: 1.81e-5), independent of pressure; slip reduces it to mu_eff in the gap.
- `ambient_pressure` (float; unit Pa; default 101325; range [0, inf)) - Ambient pressure
  Help: shared `membrane.squeeze_film_damping.ambient_pressure`
- `slip` (choice; default "veijola"; choices none | veijola) - Gas slip
  Help: shared `membrane.squeeze_film_damping.slip`
- `mean_free_path` (float; unit m; default 6.8e-08; range [0, inf); visible when slip in (veijola)) - Mean free path
  Help: shared `membrane.squeeze_film_damping.mean_free_path`
- `gap_side` (choice; default "auto"; choices auto | x_lo | x_hi | y_lo | y_hi | z_lo | z_hi) - Gap side
  Side of the solid the gap lies on: auto = the selected outer face (the gap lies outside the window there); for domain objects the direction of the face outward normal (z_lo: the bottom face of a plate over a substrate, z_hi: under a lid): of the selected objects' interface faces those flat on that axis plane, beside a solid element and facing that side, on the outermost such plane, form the footprint.
- `vents` (choice; default "all"; choices all | window_sealed | x_sealed | y_sealed | z_sealed | none) - Vented rim
  Which rim edges of the footprint vent to the ambient (p = 0; the others are sealed, no gas flux): all = the whole rim; window_sealed = rim edges lying on the domain boundary planes sealed (mirror planes of a half / quarter model), the rest vented; x_sealed / y_sealed / z_sealed = only those on the x / y / z boundary planes sealed (an in-plane axis; e.g. a strip vented on two sides); none = a closed film (needs ambient_pressure > 0: a trapped gas spring).

### Feature `solid_mechanics_3d.electrode` - Electrode

Electrode on outer faces and on domain objects (their interface faces, outer boundary faces of the object included): every node of the faces, edges and corners included, one equipotential. piezoelectric only, tetrahedron mesh (ignored with a validation warning when piezoelectric is off): an equipotential electrode, connection voltage (held phi), floating (one shared phi with a net charge) or resistive_load (one shared phi through a resistor to ground: damped modes, a loaded response). Two electrodes must not share a node (adjacent faces share their edge nodes: a build error; select both in one feature instead). Its nodes keep their mechanical supports and loads (a thin metal film without stiffness). Result 'table' of the latest static solve (eigenfrequency study: of the shown mode, per its 1 m peak displacement) with one row [feature, V, Q] (units '', V, C) and the extras V and Q: the electrode potential and the net free charge on it (Q = -sum of the potential rows of A x over its nodes, the discrete Gauss law; a voltage electrode: the charge its source delivered, so Q / V of a single driven electrode against ground is its capacitance, fringing included; a mode: the short-circuit charge of a voltage electrode, the open-circuit voltage of a floating one).

- FeatureSpec.type `electrode`; category boundary_condition
- Selection (FeatureSpec.selection): boundary entities; count at least 1; outer faces allowed; object perimeters allowed
- Mesh kinds (MeshSpec.kind): tetrahedra
- Result kind `table`

Params (FeatureSpec.params):
- `connection` (choice; default "voltage"; choices voltage | floating | resistive_load) - Connection
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics_3d.electrode.connection`
- `voltage` (float; unit V; default 0) - Voltage
  Help: shared `solid_mechanics_3d.electrode.voltage`
- `charge` (float; unit C; default 0) - Charge
  Net free charge on a floating electrode in a static solve (its voltage follows); ignored by voltage electrodes and by the eigenfrequency study (0 C).
- `load_resistance` (float; unit Ohm; default 50; range [0, inf); visible when connection in (resistive_load)) - Load resistance
  Resistance from a resistive_load electrode to ground, > 0 (typical: 50 Ohm, a matched transmission line); ignored by the other connections.
